requirements.evidence: The auth logic is largely present (`app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:26-63` validates, throttles, regenerates and redirects; `app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:30-68` does the same for registration; `app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:27-49` resets the password and rotates `remember_token`). However no `resources/views/components/layouts/app.blade.php` or `config/livewire.php`/`->layout()` exists for the full-page components, and `app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:14`, `app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:19` and `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationPromptController.php:18` return bare fragment views with no layout. `routes/web.php:21-23` also puts login/register behind `guest` without setting its redirect target to `home`, so `Login::mount()` (`app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:19-23`) is not what decides where an authenticated visitor goes.

conventions.evidence: Most Laravel conventions are followed (named routes everywhere, `$request->validate()` in controllers, `Password::defaults()` configured once in `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:24-28`, `$fillable` via the existing `#[Fillable]` on `app/Models/User.php:12`). Deviations: Livewire validation is inline at `app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:34` and `app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:50` instead of the documented `#[Validate]` attributes; the same field markup is repeated instead of Blade components (`resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:7-57`, register, forgot-password, reset-password); no docs/CHANGELOG update appears in the diff.

security.evidence: Login throttles failed attempts by lowercase e-mail + IP (`app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:66-68`), register by transliterated IP (`app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:71-73`), both send localized `auth.failed`/`auth.throttle` errors and regenerate the session on success (`Login.php:61`, `Register.php:66`). Verification checks the id and uses `hash_equals` on the e-mail hash (`app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php:16-20`), logout invalidates the session and regenerates the CSRF token (`app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:15-16`), and all views use `{{ }}`/`@csrf` with no unescaped output.

tests.evidence: `tests/Feature/AuthenticationTest.php` covers pt-BR/en rendering (`:21`, `:32`), login success/failure/throttle (`:48`, `:61`, `:73`), registration and `Registered` (`:92`, `:113`), logout (`:156`), home guards (`:166`), forgot-password status/throttle (`:180`, `:198`), reset + token rotation (`:215`), and verification tamper/resend (`:240-289`). Missing: resend and verification-link throttles, logout session/CSRF assertions, tampered-hash rejection, invalid/expired reset token, duplicate-email validation, and home markup.

simplicity.evidence: `lang/en/ui.php:64-92` and `lang/pt_BR/ui.php:64-92` contain three identical `verify`/`verification`/`email_verification` blocks plus unused `verification_sent`/`email_verification_sent` keys, and the login/register/forgot/reset forms repeat the same ~40 lines of Bulma field markup instead of one Blade component (`resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:7-57`).

readability.evidence: Component methods are small and clearly named (`Login::submit`, `Register::submit`, `VerifyEmailController::__invoke`), and controller actions read like the framework's own auth scaffold. The main drags are the 316-line single test file (`tests/Feature/AuthenticationTest.php:1-316`) and the duplicated/confusing translation blocks.

scope.evidence: Everything in the diff serves the auth task, including localizing the existing views (`resources/views/welcome.blade.php:24-44`, `resources/views/bulma-test.blade.php:3-25`) as requirement 8 demands. The only unrelated additions are the jsDelivr Bulma fallback at `resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php:13` and the duplicated unused lang keys.

issues.explanation: The only layout is `layouts.app`, but Livewire full-page components resolve the default `components.layouts.app` layout and there is no `config/livewire.php` or `->layout()` call, so `/login` and `/register` will throw a missing-view error instead of rendering.

These controllers return `auth.forgot-password`, `auth.reset-password` and `auth.verify-email` directly, but those views are bare `<div>` fragments with no `@extends`/layout, so the pages render without HTML, meta tags or Bulma styling.

Login/register are behind the `guest` middleware, whose default redirect sends authenticated users to `/`; nothing in the diff configures it to `home`, so `Login::mount()` (`app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:19-23`) never runs and requirement 4's 'authenticated users visiting login go to home' is not met.

The components validate with an inline rules array instead of the project's documented `#[Validate]` attributes on public properties, so they diverge from the Livewire pattern the convention requires.
The same labelled input/error markup is copy-pasted across four forms instead of being extracted into an anonymous Blade component as the Bulma/UI conventions require.

Several required behaviours are untested: the resend and verification-link throttles, logout session invalidation/CSRF rotation, a tampered verification hash (only the id is tampered), an invalid/expired reset token, and duplicate-email registration.

The named-route test uses non-recursive `glob` patterns (PHP has no `**` globstar) and only asserts the absence of root-relative `href`/`action`, so it does not prove the views use `route()` and may miss views.

Three identical 10-line verification blocks and two duplicate top-level keys are defined in both locales, though only `ui.verify.*` and `ui.verification.sent` are used, leaving dead copy-pasted translations.

issues.location: CHANGELOG.md and docs/ (not present in the diff)
issues.explanation: The project convention requires docs and `CHANGELOG.md` to be updated in the same change, but the new auth flow, routes and locale defaults are undocumented.
The layout adds a jsDelivr Bulma fallback that bypasses the project's Vite build and introduces an unrequested external dependency.

review.summary: The change implements most of the session-auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, e-mail verification, pt-BR/en translations and a broad Pest suite) but the full-page Livewire layout is never wired, so `/login` and `/register` cannot render, and the controller-backed auth views are unwrapped fragments. The guest redirect to `home`, the missing `#[Validate]` convention and the duplicated markup/translations need changes before merging.
